notes.title: Hotfix for Minor Bugs
notes.notes:
We’ve found a couple of minor bugs on our journey through The Gray City that we’ve managed to stamp out!

This latest hotfix will mean that Voidwrought is now updated to Build 1.1.33.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2014550/Voidwrought/

We’ve included the following bug fixes in this hotfix:

 Fixed the issue where players would get stuck when quitting out of the Shrine cutscene.
 Fixed the issue where HP from other runs wouldn’t transfer over to NG+ Undone save.

Thank you so much once again to everyone who has helped us by providing their feedback and bug reports!

If you do encounter any other bugs or would like to give feedback on your experience of Voidwrought so far, we’d love to hear from you either in our Steam Forum or on Discord.

notes.title: Hotfix for Bugs and Minor NG+ Issues
notes.notes:
While we try to keep The Gray City as bug free as possible, sometimes a quick dose of cosmic pesticide is exactly what it needs!

This latest hotfix will mean that Voidwrought is now updated to Build 1.1.29. If you are taking part in our speedrunning competition, please ensure you have updated your build before continuing your runs.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2014550/Voidwrought/

We’ve included the following bug fixes in this hotfix:

 Fixed an issue with the Pustulant Prince’s death animation. 
 Fixed an issue that affected players health upon restarting the Undone Mode.
 Fixed an issue where The Grand Bazaar region would reset in NG+ mode.
 Fixed an issue with the Strange Stalks dialogue box.
 Fixed an issue where some previously found relics could be unlocked in NG+ mode.
 Ensured that only artifacts available for purchase will be displayed in Qagat’s shop.
 Ensured that controls will no longer reset when using the 8BitDo Ultimate controller. 

Thank you so much once again to everyone who has helped us by providing their feedback and bug reports!

If you do encounter any other bugs or would like to give feedback on your experience of Voidwrought so far, we’d love to hear from you either in our Steam Forum or on Discord.

notes.title: Patch #4: More Quality of Life Changes and Balancing
notes.notes:
The Relics strewn throughout The Gray City have lain covered in dust for many hundreds of years, so we’ve decided to give them a good polish!

In this latest patch (Build 1.0.16), we’ve implemented a bit more balancing, particularly related to the Relics, some quality of life changes, and even more bug fixes.

Read on to find out more about whether your favorite Relic has been given an upgrade.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2014550/Voidwrought/

When it comes to combat balancing, we’ve made the following changes:


 Lowered the HP of the following bosses: the Astronomer, the Pustulant Prince, and The Weeper.
 Tweaked the attack cooldowns of the following bosses: the Astronomer, the Pustulant Prince, and The Weeper.
 Tweaked the AoE hurtbox of the Pustulant Prince so it deactivates faster.
 Increased the HP of phase 2 during the Myrmidon encounter.
 Lowered the HP of the following common enemies: Black Wasp, Slugsac, and Carver.
 Increased drops for most bosses;
 Increased the HP of common enemies in the Obsidian Observatory.

We’ve adjusted the following Relics and Souls to increase their damage. Some of these Relics will also scale with the player by adding a percentage of the player’s damage to their base damage:


 Astronomer’s Band
 Chakram
 Spectral Blade
 The Chained
 Crystalline Lens
 The Godseye
 Sky-shard
 Condensed Light
 Living Talon
 Censer of Ta-Hun
 Jazier the Pompous
 Volatile Jar
 The Servant
 The Forgotten Warrior
 Idol of So-Venat
 Serrated Gland
 The Legion
 Spectral Axe
 Mutated Gastropod

Alongside the balancing changes, we’ve made a few of level design changes and some quality of life changes:


 The Vault in the Court has been moved to The Deep Bazaar.
 The Ancient Cipher in Mirrorways has been moved to the room behind The Skychild.
 The Salt Shard in the room behind the Skychild has been moved to the Mirrorways.
 Two resource nodes have been added in the Mirrorways.
 Added a Relic Fragment at the beginning of the path leading to the Skychild.
 Removed the Archaic Ward blocking the way up to the Skychild.
 Swapped positions of the location indicators for The Grand Bazaar and The Deep Bazaar in the Translocation Room.

Last but not least, the following bug fixes are also included in this patch:


 Fixed an issue where the incorrect button prompt to breach is displayed during the breaching animation for the possession mechanism in the Gardens.
 Fixed a small map issue at the “lamp puzzle” in the Court.
 Fixed an issue where the player character would play the wrong animation for a brief moment after defeating multiple bosses.
 Fixed an issue where the camera shake effect would play with the setting set to 0.

Thank you so much once again to everyone who has helped us by providing their feedback and bug reports!

If you do encounter any other bugs or would like to give feedback on your experience of Voidwrought so far, we’d love to hear from you either in our Steam Forum or on Discord.

notes.title: Patch #3: Our First Major Quality of Life and Balancing Patch
notes.notes:
While The Gray City has always been divided between the weak and the strong, the balance must be delicately maintained…

Thanks to your feedback, we’ve decided to implement some major quality of life changes and boss fight balancing as part of our third patch (Build 1.0.12), along with lots of bug fixes!

Read on to find out more about who has been empowered, and who has been enfeebled.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2014550/Voidwrought/


We’ve made the following major quality of life changes based on community feedback:


 The Explorer Soul: If equipped, The Explorer will now “ping” when the player enters a room with an undiscovered secret. The Explorer will also start to ping when the player gets close enough to an undiscovered secret, and the frequency will slightly increase once the player moves closer. The ping consists of VFX, SFX, and controller vibration.
 The Shunned Library in the Shrine has been updated with a tracker for the amount of Anamnestic Recollections turned in to Ose the Archaeologist, as well as an indicator for how many are left.
 Whispering Stones are now tracked under Regions in the Compendium.
 The Vizier: A memory of the Vizier will appear even after the Vizier has met her demise, allowing the player to talk to her and complete quests.
 Dropped Health shard pickups are now more visible.


Alongside these quality of life changes, we’ve also made the following balancing changes to combat in Voidwrought:


General Combat


 Player invulnerability time upon getting hit has been reduced. 

Boss Fights


The Council 

 Reduced the chase duration of the third phase.
 The third phase will drop a health pickup when defeated.
 Lowered the HP for each head/phase.

The Eternal Engine

 Lowered the amount of adds for each wave.
 Removed the Copter from the enemy roster.
 Boss downtime increased.

The Skychild

 Reduced most cooldowns.
 Increased Projectile Speed.
 Increased Projectile Targeting Speed.
 Room Sweeper and AoE now push the player away.
 Slight HP increase.

The Absolute Indexer

 Reduced most cooldowns.
 Speed of the Laser Pincer attack and Laser Sweeper attack increased.
 Slight HP increase.

The Astronomer

 Reduced most cooldowns.
 The possible number of active bounce projectiles increases during the fight, so they will stack over time.
 Some changes in the behavior.
 Slight HP increase.

Uut the Screamer

 Room Sweeper attacks now greatly push the player back.
 When damaging the boss for the first time, a sneaky horde of Wights will appear to the right.
 Slight HP increase.

The Fermented

 The Fermented now checks the player’s position and will act accordingly. 
 Telegraph VFX added to the puke attack.
 Attack cooldown after charge added.
 Fermented will always charge the first thing it does.
 More refined hurt and hitboxes were added to better match the charge and projectile telegraph animations.
 Slight HP increase.

The Font

 Tsunami hurtboxes are better defined and deactivate quicker.
 Most of the animation wind-ups and wind-downs are quicker.
 Phase thresholds adjusted.
 Slight HP increase.

The Pustulant Prince

 Reduced most cooldowns.
 Increased movement speed.
 Increased movement speed of the projectile.
 Added AoE on boss stomp.
 Slight HP increase.

The Weeper

 Reduced most cooldowns.
 Projectile speed increased.
 Room Sweeper speed increased.
 Instead of the prison spawning around the eye when staggered, it will now trigger an AoE.
 Slight HP increase.

The First

 Burning platform damage increased. 
 Homing projectile damage increased. 
 HP increased.


Below, you’ll also find a list of all of the smaller quality of life changes, balancing, and bug fixes we’ve added into our third patch:


 Adjusted drops for most resource nodes across the game.
 Certain Ancient Ciphers (Vault Keys) have been removed from rooms in: the Abandoned Expedition - Exchanged for Relic Fragment; the Commons - Exchanged for Divine Remnant; The Court - Exchanged for Divine Remnant; and The Gardens - Exchanged for Ichor Resource node and moved to The Grand Bazaar.
 The Gilded Emporium will now buy Ancient Ciphers if all Vaults have been opened and if there is a surplus of Ancient Ciphers in the player’s inventory
 Added a cutscene event for The Lost when it hatches.
 The Servant will now take The Lost’s place in the Soul Inventory when they swap (instead of leaving a blank slot).
 The Star Soul: Decreased projectile lifetime and greatly increased the size of the hurtbox. 
 Shrine Keeper: The Keeper will now also comment on the Prince if it’s the last boss that’s been defeated by the player.
 Time-lost Scholar enemy VFX and SFX improvements.
 Mutilant enemy VFX and SFX improvements.
 Alchemist enemy VFX and SFX improvements.
 The Mutated Gastropod relic has received VFX and SFX improvements, and can now also light up dark areas.
 The Serrated Gland relic has received VFX and SFX improvements.
 The Warp-Hook relic’s safety distance to walls has been increased slightly.
 The Warp-Hook relic has received VFX and SFX improvements.
 The Star, Forgotten Warrior, The Attendant, The Living Blade, The Servant, and The Legion souls have received VFX and SFX improvements.
 So-Venat now awakens if the player moves close without having to reload or reenter the Shrine.
The Endless Kaleidoscope is now gained from the Grand Artificer instead of Qagat the Burdened
 Polished the Wrappings of Namun Relic.
 Fixed an issue where some players would get stuck in The Court due to a certain set of Simulacra. 
 Fixed an issue with the Assassin enemy disappearing through the floor.
 Fixed player character appearing stuck for a moment on entering some rooms. 
 Players can no longer simply slide to reach the Dash Simulacrum entrance. 
 Fixed blacked out areas in Slither passages.
 Players can no longer traverse below salt vats without The Impure Soul equipped. 
 Fixed an issue where the player disappeared after using slither between certain rooms.  
 Potential fix for disappearing saves. Due to the very rare occurrence of this bug, it has been hard to diagnose, so if it persists we will keep investigating.


Thank you once again to all of our players for providing us with so much feedback and reporting the bugs that you’ve found so far!

If you do encounter any other bugs or would like to give feedback on your experience of Voidwrought so far, we’d love to hear from you either in our Steam Forum or on Discord.

notes.title: Patch #2: More Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
You may have thought our bug excavation of The Gray City was over…

And you’d be wrong!

Our second smaller patch includes even more bug fixes and some quality of life changes for you to enjoy.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2014550/Voidwrought/


Here’s a list of the bug fixes and quality of life changes included in Build 1.0.7:


 Ose Softlock Failsafe: Loading a save with the Ose softlock will put the player in the Shrine
 Ose Softlock Failsafe: Ose won’t save the player’s position anymore
 Vaults won’t save the player’s position anymore
 Removed Unstable Nuclei “gate” after the Fermented boss to prevent possible softlocks
 A hitbox of a secret in the Gardens now deactivates as it should
 Set correct button prompts for the gate to the Court in the Commons.
 Room before the Prince modified to prevent the player becoming stuck in the pit when not having certain Simulacra
 Void Step Targets are now faintly indicated even when obscured or hidden within secret areas
 The extra health slots provided by the Slave soul are now refilled from all healing sources
 Relic Containers now spawn after the North Encounter in the Abandoned Expedition and after the Alchemist Miniboss to prevent rare cases of rewards being missed


Thank you once again to all of our players for your detailed bug reports!

If you do encounter any other bugs or would like to give feedback on your experience of Voidwrought so far, we’d love to hear from you either in our Steam Forum or on Discord.

notes.title: Patch #1: Two New Languages Added and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
The Gray City may be plagued by a myriad of dark and twisted creatures, but there's one nefarious beast that we hope to never see...

Bugs 🐞

That's why we'd like to thank all of the players who have helped us by submitting bug reports so that we can hunt down and squash as many bugs as possible!

Before we get into the bug fixes though, we’re excited to announce that we’ve added Traditional Chinese and Hungarian to Voidwrought, or should we say…

我們加入了繁體中文！

A magyar nyelv mostantól elérhető!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2014550/Voidwrought/


In this patch, we've made significant changes to keyboard remapping, including:


 Fixed many instances of possible softlocking out of certain menus
 Blocked Esc and Enter keys from being assignable to prevent double mapping certain actions
 Fixed instances of certain actions being double mapped and not working in-game properly
 Fixed some instances of wrong or white glyphs being displayed
 Esc and Enter can be used in menus, however, a mapped button will be displayed


On top of that, please find below a list of all of the other bug fixes and quality of life changes included in Build 1.0.6:


 Fixed softlocks and save issues caused by camera shake being set to 0
 Fixed issue where exiting some rooms upwards while using the Unstable Nuclei ability made the player fall out of bounds
 Added 1 Progenitor Flesh pickup to ensure enough are available
 The Gilded Emporium now sells Relic Fragments.
 Lone Crewman quest - Putrid Remains are now removed from the inventory upon quest completion
 It’s no longer possible to mistakenly delete save files when alt+tabbed out of the game on the save slot screen
 Improved visual cues for pogo attack tutorial at the beginning of the game
 Increased cooldowns for most relics for balancing and to prevent some problems when using the Astronomer Soul
 The save in the Shrine won’t save the player’s location anymore
 The Lost Soul now correctly consumes the Ichor when slotted instead of letting the Player keep it
 Art and audio polish on Subjugated and Emissary enemies
 Balanced one of the Lost Gardens encounters
 Impossible Anomaly Relic visual and audio polish
 Absolute Indexer boss - fix for getting stuck inside the walls when using pogo attack
 Fixed possibility of being locked out from a fight with Time-Lost Scholars
 Fixed Condensed Light relic beam being stuck in the Weeper fight
 Fixed wrong animation state on jumping through a door in Abandoned Expedition
 Fixed lasers not damaging the player character in Observatory
 Fixed the player respawning outside of one of the save rooms in the Grand Bazaar
 Fixed Eternal Engine boss not using his spike attack under certain conditions
 Fixed the main core texture being white under certain conditions during Eternal Engine boss fight
 Chronicler enemy should now react to Chrono Canister Relic
 Alchemist should not disappear mid-fight anymore


Thank you once again to all of our players for your detailed bug reports!

If you do encounter any other bugs or would like to give feedback on your experience of Voidwrought so far, we’d love to hear from you either in our Steam Forum or on Discord.
